description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) server-side implementation, including the t_server class, related methods, and negotiation protocol details.

classes.name: t_server
classes.description: Represents the SRP server session state, including cryptographic parameters, session keys, and buffers.

methods.name: t_serveropen
methods.description: Initializes a server session with a username.

methods.name: t_serveropenfromfiles
methods.description: Initializes a server session using password and configuration files.

methods.name: t_serveropenraw
methods.description: Initializes a server session with raw password entry and configuration.

methods.name: t_servergenexp
methods.description: Generates a random 256-bit exponent and computes g raised to that power.

methods.name: t_servergetkey
methods.description: Computes the session key from the client's exponential w(p).

methods.name: t_serverresponse
methods.description: Computes the session key proof for verification.

methods.name: t_serverclose
methods.description: Closes the session and frees resources.
